tools.name: search-cheat-sheet
tools.title: Search Shell Cheat Sheet
tools.description: Search configured shell shortcuts, commands, file handlers, and cautions. Read-only: does not read history or execute commands.

ai.instructions: Use search-cheat-sheet to answer questions about this configured shell, not generic Zsh defaults. Search with concise keywords, a command, a shortcut, or a category; omit the query to browse the catalogue. Every query word must match, so retry with fewer keywords if no tips match. Explain the returned examples, shortcuts, and cautions accurately. Do not invent configured bindings or usage counts. This tool neither reads personal history nor executes commands.
